data.why: The repo ships realistic example CSV/XLSX data (gas-law PVT data, MD energy/RMSD trajectories, a generic test table) plus a package-internal gallery of artificial datasets (IR spectrum, reaction kinetics, bimodal/normal distributions, molecular properties) reachable from the Data Upload page's built-in loader, so no synthetic data needs to be authored.

goals: Upload a tabular dataset (CSV/Excel) and preview its shape, column types, and summary statistics
Generate a quick plot (e.g. scatter or line) from uploaded data and style it for publication
Fit a curve (e.g. exponential decay or kinetics model) to data in Analysis Tools and inspect fit parameters and residuals
Load a built-in IR spectrum example in Spectroscopy, find peaks, and measure FWHM
Build a multi-plot dashboard combining several plots with shared axes and export it as a combined PNG/PDF
Run a batch analysis preset over multiple example files and export a summary report

review.summary: The tree is accurate about what the agent clicked, its specific labels match the UI, and the cited screens show the right states. But it covers only about 5 of the 14 pages, misses the multi-plot, cleaning and export/report stages that the README and plan put at the centre, files Band Assignment under the wrong page, and presents three scientifically broken results (degenerate exponential fit, noise peaks with negative widths, empty band assignments) as working tasks. Fix those labels and placement and add the missing stages before filing.
